# EQfy - Louder Volume

> EQfy - Louder Volume (on the US App Store as "Volume Booster Sound Amplifier") is an iPhone app that makes music and audio files louder and better: a volume booster up to 200% (+12 dB), a bass booster, a 7-band equalizer with 9 presets, 3D audio, left/right balance, a haptic player and AI Studio tools (music generator, sound effects, text to speech, noise reducer).

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 16 or later. Free to download; optional Premium subscription. Rated 4.5 on the US App Store.
- EQfy boosts audio played inside EQfy (imported songs, Files, discovered tracks). iOS does not allow it to boost other apps, calls or system sounds.
- iPhone Duo support (full inner display, sidebar and side-by-side layouts) is coming in v2.2.23.
- Support: support@eqfy.app · App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6550912161
- Developer: Taras Chernysh (App Store seller). The App Store listing name differs by country; App ID 6550912161 is the same app everywhere. Apps with similar names come from other developers.
